title: Qaid Hokar Chale
body:
qaid hokar chale to ye bole haram
laashe shaahe zaman alwida alwida
aayi hogi yehi ran se sheh ki sada
meri dukhiya behan alwida alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
is tarha suye zindan farwa chali
dahste ghurbat mein padkar ye noha chali
teri pamaliyan kaise bhoolungi mai
mere nazuk badan alwida alwida
qaid hokar chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe akbar pe rokar ye kehti thi maa
qaid hokar chali utho kadiyal jawan
maa phuphi behne balwe mein hai nange sar
akbar e khastatan alwida alwida
qaid hokar chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti aayi nazar ek maa chashme tar
khaak par so'oge ay noor e nazar
tere zakhmi galay par ho qurban maa
mere ghuncha-dahan alwida alwida
qaid hokar chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
sochti hoo yehi kaise zinda rahi
dekh kar teri gardan pe chalti churi
qabr tak leke jaungi majaaye mai
dil pe ranj o mehan alwida alwida
qaid hokar chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ye aayi khabar hogaye sab reha
qaid khane mein ek hashr barpa hua
nanhi turbat pe abid ne rokar kaha
ay sakina behan alwida alwida
qaid hokar chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
nehr se khafila jab guzarne laga
moo chupa kar ye zainab ne rokar kaha
kaise bechadari dekh payega tu
sher e khyber shikan alwida alwida
qaid hokar chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab reha hoke aaye haram karbala
ay zafar roke zainab ne us dam kaha
mere majaaye gar ho ijazat teri
jaye ab hum watan alwida alwida
qaid hokar chale...
author: Zafar Abbas
